Seeded CfC networks with function-preserving hidden-unit permutations at one and multiple layers, paired genuine faults, exact functional probes, and held-out permutations. One-layer/no-backbone and multi-layer/no-residual/no-backbone cases are separate registered strata. Each layer's alignment is measured from a frozen, source-bound functional probe sequence; the transform must propagate adjacent-layer input-column permutations, recurrent row/column permutations, layer-local bias/time-constant permutations, and final output-column permutations through the typed WeightProgram and candidate-only SWI adapter. Fault labels remain withheld from the proposer.

Exact Friston et al. (2026) three-ball active structure-learning reproduction target: partially observed discrete POMDP with five latent factors (three ball-colour factors, each with red/green/blue states; one look-location factor with start/left/centre/right; one choice factor with no-choice/red/blue/green), two outcome modalities (vision: nothing/red/green/blue; feedback: no-feedback/correct/incorrect), action-controlled gaze and choice, random ball colours per trial, and six time points per trial (five moves). Relative log preferences for feedback are [0, 2, -6] nats in the order no-feedback/correct/incorrect. The hidden rule is a context-dependent mapping from centre-ball colour to the criterion location (red→left, green→centre, blue→right); the model family contains 81 possible mappings (79 unique after degeneracy), with rule 65 as the planted generating rule. The generative model is assumed known except for the feedback likelihood tensor. Any change to these factors, outcomes, time horizon, priors, rule family, or model-space construction is a separately labelled adaptation. Source qualification note: the pinned public SPM implementation reproduces 81 labelled mappings but exact feedback-likelihood tensor equality yields 75 semantic classes, while the paper reports 79 unique rules. This discrepancy remains unresolved; the public-source implementation is a source-pinned reconstruction/audit, not an exact reproduction, until archived source or the paper's uniqueness criterion reconciles it. A separate unit fixture evaluates feedback-only model EIG conditional on a known ball-colour state across 4 choices (including no-choice), and checks the 81-label vs 75-class quotient; it is not the full POMDP or gaze/vision EIG. The current executable feedback-only fixture conditions on a known ball-colour state and applies a shared count increment; it must remain labelled as a known-state unit fixture. A full POMDP reproduction additionally requires action/outcome-conditioned posterior expectations over hidden parent states, with provenance and the exact Bayesian-model-average or model-conditioned update convention declared. Do not reuse one shared known-state increment as evidence of full partially observed state inference.

Sequential prediction-and-discovery environment with a frozen initial predictor, repeated assay/measurement batches, endpoint-budget constraints, optional task/regime shifts, and a fixed editable WeightProgram interface. The proposer receives only evidence available before each decision; hidden held-out endpoints and future batches remain sealed. Distinguish a fixed edit program authored once and executed repeatedly from an editor re-prompted on every batch.

Matched small-network families with identical architecture and input/output dimensions but different hidden task functions, generated labels, output-action semantics, and temporal behaviours. Include both public-task replicas and held-out procedurally generated tasks. The evaluator receives raw weights plus a frozen, budgeted probe set; task names, dataset names, class order, and training metadata are withheld. Interventions independently permute output labels, permute hidden coordinates, shuffle weights within shape/scale strata, and perturb selected parameter groups. A separate verifier can inspect exact function outputs and intervention outcomes.

Finite-hypothesis three-ball task with a joint posterior over source or semantic-quotient rule identity and 27 hidden ball-colour configurations. Candidate policies compare immediate colour choice against one gaze observation, posterior conditioning, and a downstream choice. This is a two-step receding-horizon adapter, not the full SPM POMDP or a parameter-learning benchmark.

metrics.energy: Report only when device, power instrumentation, limits, and aggregation protocol are documented and reproducible.

analysis_plan.pairing: Pair all task seeds, fault instances, and scenarios across all sixteen profiles and baselines.
analysis_plan.uncertainty: Report per-task effect sizes, distributions across seeds, and 95% confidence intervals; use exact binomial intervals for false-edit rates.
analysis_plan.multiplicity: Predeclare primary contrasts and apply Holm correction across registered primary tests.
analysis_plan.interaction: Estimate preregistered H×C×F×W interaction effects; do not infer synergy from the full profile alone. Include an explicit equivalence subgroup contrast: healthy permutation-only controls must not be classified as faults.
analysis_plan.budgets: Match proposer candidates, forward passes, tuning opportunities, parameter counts, and compute. Report unmatched deviations.
analysis_plan.holdout: Holdout labels/results are inaccessible to proposer, policy, editor, and tuning. Open once for final report; no post-hoc retuning.
analysis_plan.healthy_controls: Include enough independent healthy networks to estimate low false-edit rates. A low observed count from a small sample is not a low-risk guarantee.
analysis_plan.reporting: Publish null/negative results, all registered contrasts, failed runs, and artifact/source digests.

hard_gates: All sixteen unique H×C×F×W profiles must be present exactly once and each factor setting must match its profile ID.
Each enabled/disabled factor must have an explicit adapter and runtime receipt proving which implementation actually ran.
Protocol-only validation must never mark any profile as executed or emit task-performance claims.
Exact source SHA, protocol digest, task revision, profile, baseline, seed/split, tuning budget, and result artifact digests are mandatory.
Development and held-out seeds are disjoint; no held-out label or result may leak into model, policy, proposer, verifier tuning, or candidate selection.
FEP information gain must be prospective, model-relative, action-dependent, and based on outcome likelihoods/posteriors; novelty or entropy of deterministic predicted states is insufficient.
The information-channel-off control must remove the information-selection benefit while reward, action cost, and novelty accounting remain fixed.
WSP must write only to isolated candidate copies through typed SWI operations with exact base-digest preconditions.
Stale digests, malformed dimensions, duplicate conflicting groups, non-finite values, invalid tau, norm/budget violations, or algebra-invariant violations must fail closed before mutation.
Healthy networks and sham fault metadata must be included; false edits to healthy models must be reported with confidence intervals.
Repair success must include held-out target improvement and non-target collateral-regression measurements.
Weights-only and trace-assisted WSP results must be reported separately.
Gradient, analytic, black-box, random matched-sparsity, no-edit, and task-appropriate conventional baselines must be budget-matched.
Primary contrasts, multiple-comparison procedure, and stop conditions must be preregistered before held-out evaluation.
Incomplete execution, skipped tests, queued workflows, missing baselines, invalid outputs, or integrity failures are non-qualification states.
No SOTA, production readiness, general self-improvement, safety certification, biological equivalence, or consciousness claim follows from this protocol.
Function-preserving hidden-unit permutations are negative controls; raw parameter distance alone cannot label a behavior change.
Any permutation alignment is diagnostic metadata and must not silently rewrite the source checkpoint or alter native digest semantics.
Cross-permutation repair is scored only after held-out function equivalence and preservation tests; oracle alignments are upper bounds, not proposer inputs.
State-, parameter-, and model-structure information gains are reported separately only when their generative models and posterior updates are explicitly defined.
Any aggregation of epistemic terms declares its factorization and is checked against a joint mutual-information chain-rule calculation; arbitrary entropy deltas cannot be added.
Bayesian Model Reduction or another model-selection procedure must be qualified against held-out model evidence and cannot commit a structural change from a probe ranking alone.

Hierarchical epistemic terms are derived from one declared joint posterior and action-conditioned outcome model; their sum must agree with the joint mutual-information chain rule within numerical tolerance.

Bayesian Model Reduction is applied only to prior-only reductions that share one parameterization; the posterior/full-prior pair and exact-vs-variational posterior status are recorded, and non-integrable ratios are rejected.

The CfC symmetry fixture must execute the function-preserving hidden-unit permutation through WeightProgram and the candidate-only SWI adapter, verify distinct native fingerprints with held-out functional equivalence, and verify that an incomplete permutation changes outputs.

The three-ball task is labelled an exact reproduction only when the paper/supplement state space, rule set, preference distribution, observation likelihoods, action constraints, and stopping rule are transcribed and independently verified; otherwise it must be named a task adaptation.
BMR log evidence is used only for post-observation model comparison; it is not added directly to prospective expected information gain or pragmatic value.

All Gaussian distributions supplied to BMR (full posterior, full prior, and each reduced prior) carry the same canonical parameterization digest binding coordinate identities, semantic roles, tensor shapes, and coordinate order; missing, malformed, or mismatched digests are rejected before evidence calculation.

Activation-based hidden-unit correspondence is diagnostic only: the source model is unchanged, native fingerprints are not rewritten, and low-margin or ambiguous assignments must abstain. Report probe-set identity, signature error, and assignment margin for every attempted alignment.

The three-ball implementation records the paper's published rule (centre green→green; centre red→left colour; centre blue→right colour), foveated single-ball observation, and outcome preference log probabilities (no feedback=0, correct=2, incorrect=-6 nats); any changed mechanism is labelled as an adaptation.

The three-ball categorical likelihood reproduction must use Dirichlet model reduction over the full-model posterior and prior concentrations; the diagonal-Gaussian BMR primitive must not be substituted for this conjugate categorical case.

Three-ball model evidence must use the registered model family and Dirichlet column ordering, and the reported Occam threshold must be expressed as posterior model log-odds in nats; model commitment is evaluated at the declared 16-nat threshold as a replication metric, not as a universal constant.

Dirichlet BMR requires positive concentrations on active coordinates and an explicit active-support mask; inactive coordinates must have exactly zero concentration, and any posterior count in an excluded coordinate makes that reduced model's evidence zero. Empty or malformed support and non-integrable reduced posteriors are rejected.

The one-step Dirichlet model-EIG evaluator must compute current and post-outcome model beliefs from BMR, weight posterior model entropy by the full Bayesian-model-average parent predictive outcome distribution, and must not reweight the predictive distribution by Bayes factors a second time.

The parent Dirichlet prior used for prospective model EIG must equal the reduced-model-prior arithmetic mean under the registered model probabilities; predictive outcome probabilities must be normalized, and hypothetical sufficient-statistic increments must match the exact parameterization and be finite and non-negative.

Adaptive functional-probe selection must report the full frozen candidate pool, selected probe, per-candidate accumulated assignment margin and mean activation error, source/candidate/architecture/manifest digests, and the final ordered probe-set digest. It must be deterministic and must not mutate either model.

Probe selection and alignment fitting must use a declared selection-probe pool; final functional-equivalence and acceptance metrics must use a disjoint held-out probe sequence not used for selection, threshold tuning, or assignment fitting.

Accumulated assignment margin is computed from summed squared activation differences across probes, while the reported fit error remains mean-squared activation error; the same mapping repeated across independent probes must increase the margin in proportion to probe count without changing mean fit error.

The three-ball source audit preserves the 81 labelled SPM hypotheses and equal 1/81 prior mass. It independently canonicalizes the exact full feedback likelihood tensors and records the current public-generator result of 75 semantic classes (three triplicate constant mappings) against the paper-reported 79. The exact-reproduction status remains blocked until this discrepancy is reconciled against the paper's archived code/uniqueness criterion; neither model labels nor priors may be silently deduplicated.

CfC symmetry canonicalization must bind to the current source and candidate native model digests, shared architecture/manifest digests, and accepted alignment receipt; it must only target the registered one-layer, non-residual, no-backbone topology, use the coupled five-group permutation, materialize on a candidate clone, recover the canonical fixture digest, and preserve the candidate's function on disjoint held-out input sequences.

The sequential WeightProgram benchmark must distinguish one fixed editor-authored program reused across evidence batches from per-batch editor re-prompting; report LLM calls, candidate evaluations, update count, inference cost, and endpoint budget separately.

Every sequential edit is bound to the exact model, program, target specification, evidence-batch digest, and verifier receipt; candidates are evaluated on predeclared held-out observations and promoted only through a separate explicit acceptance boundary.

Future measurement batches, hidden endpoints, and held-out assay outcomes are inaccessible to the editor and probe selector; include a leakage canary and report all candidate evaluations, rollbacks, and unsuccessful edits.

Sequential WSP results are compared with no-edit, random matched-norm, feedback-blind, re-prompted WSP, and matched online/gradient baselines under identical evidence batches and endpoint budgets; online-replay author-reported results are not treated as independent replication.

The multi-layer CfC canonicalizer must use one fresh, fingerprint-bound activation-alignment receipt per layer, validate every layer index exactly once, propagate each layer permutation through the next layer's input columns, and verify full held-out output equivalence on candidate-only materialization. Residual, bidirectional, and backbone topologies remain explicitly unsupported.

Weight-space semantic-reading results must include randomized output labels/action names and task families absent from public training corpora; familiar dataset-name recognition alone is not accepted as function understanding.

At least one intervention must test causal predictions about outputs after a targeted parameter-group or hidden-unit manipulation; unverified verbal interpretations are not scored as correct semantic recovery.
Report architecture-only, raw-weight-only, probe-assisted, and intervention-assisted semantic-reading baselines separately under matched information, tool, token, and probe budgets.

The source-faithful 81-label rule family is retained. Any semantic quotient is an explicit secondary representation with prior mass aggregated over exact-likelihood-equivalence classes; prior predictive distributions, model evidence, class posteriors, and action rankings must match the labelled family within declared numerical tolerances.

The causal weight-reading task must distinguish structural weight arithmetic from semantic interpretation: output labels and task names are randomized, label permutations are hidden from the reader, and predictions are scored against actual outputs under sealed parameter-group interventions. Dataset-name guesses alone never count as successful interpretation.

The feedback-only known-state three-ball quotient fixture is reported separately from full-task reproduction; it must compare prospective Dirichlet model-EIG, predictive outcome masses, post-outcome semantic-class posterior aggregation, and action rankings across 81 labelled versus 75 quotient hypotheses, including a no-choice zero-information control.

Prospective Dirichlet model-EIG derives each action-outcome probability as the mixture of per-model posterior-predictive probabilities weighted by the current posterior model belief from BMR; it rejects missing, duplicate, or unknown model IDs, per-model predictive distributions that do not normalize, and caller-supplied aggregate probabilities that disagree with the reconstructed mixture.

The known-ball-state feedback-only Dirichlet EIG fixture must not be reported as full POMDP reproduction. Full partial-observation qualification requires action/outcome-conditioned parent-state posterior expectations and a declared, provenance-bound sufficient-statistic update convention; a shared known-state count increment is insufficient.

The known-state feedback action scorer is evaluated separately from the full partially observed task. It must reproduce G(a)=KL[Q(feedback|a,D)||C(feedback)]-lambda_info*I(model;feedback|a,D)+action_cost under a fixed known ball-colour state and fixed gaze, with the three-ball feedback log preferences [0,2,-6] nats in no-feedback/correct/incorrect order.

The known-state action score is compared against random, pragmatic-only (lambda_info=0), model-EIG-only, and combined one-step FEP-style baselines under the same legal action set and cost; preference risk, model EIG, epistemic weight, and action cost are reported separately. This is not evidence of full POMDP performance or production ActiveInferenceAgent integration.
The three-ball source-reproduction profile must use the pinned SPM globally normalized prior over all Dirichlet tensor entries, not independent per-column arithmetic normalization.

The three-ball source-reproduction profile must apply the pinned SPM 1/32 pseudocount to every posterior, full-prior, and reduced-prior coordinate in Dirichlet model evidence; strict structural-zero BMR is registered as a separate ablation.

The BMR reference test must reproduce spm_MDP_log_evidence with first-dimension multivariate-beta columns and source-pinned SPM revision metadata; the source digest and formula must be recorded in the experiment receipt.
The three-ball partial-observation policy maintains a normalized joint P(model,state) belief; it must not replace it with independent marginals after evidence introduces model/state correlation.
Gaze information is measured as model information plus conditional state information I(State; Observation | Model); the joint mutual-information chain-rule residual is reported and bounded.
The two-step gaze/choice policy is labelled a bounded receding-horizon approximation; it is not called a full SPM POMDP reproduction or a continuous-parameter learner.
A constant visual sensor independent of hidden state must produce zero conditional state information gain; impossible observations must fail closed.
